events.name: Fortas Chamber Music Concerts: Jennifer Koh: Bach and Beyond
events.info: Jennifer Koh, Artistic Director of Fortas Chamber Music Concerts and one of todays leading violinists, brings her acclaimed Bach & Beyond project to the stage. Hailed as an epic traversal of solo violin repertoire and a monumental achievement (Chicago Tribune), this performance is a mesmerizing conversation between the music of Johann Sebastian Bach and the generations of composers who have reimagined what Kohs instrument can do. Grammy Award winning and celebrated for her fearless musicianship, Koh has devoted much of her extraordinary career to expanding the possibilities of the violin. Join us for this one-night-only concert connecting Bachs enduring legacy with the limitless world beyond it.

events.info: Experience the official 'Outlander' in-concert event! A live orchestra performs Bear McCreary's acclaimed score, curated by showrunner Matthew B. Roberts, while highlights from eight seasons illuminate the screen. From Craigh na Dun to the New World, relive Claire and Jamie's journey as Scotland's Celtic sound takes the spotlight. Outlander in Concert celebrates the show's rich heritage, the timeless romance between Claire and Jamie, the sweeping landscapes that made us fall in love, and a tasting experience from Sassenach Spirits. Premiering in Scotland; the heart and home of 'Outlander', Echoes of The Highlands will fill the air, reminding us that this is not the end, but just the beginning DOORS open at 6:30 PM. SHOW starts at 7:30 PM. For general ticketing and event questions, please contact the Warner Box Office at WarnerBoxOffice@LiveNation.com. For Premium Seating information, please reach out to Maryclaire Griffin at MaryclaireGriffin@LiveNation.com or call 202-626-8255.
events.pleaseNote: Join us on the Warner Building rooftop for food, drinks, games & music 2 hours before showtime. Entrance is free. Food & drinks are not. All Balcony & Suite seating requires climbing stairs, as there are no elevators in the Theatre. Only bags 12" x 6" x 12" or smaller are permitted. No backpacks allowed. Accessible seating is in Row Z (Orchestra). Seats are non fixed, padded, and armless, and can be removed for mobility devices or left for companions. Purchase accessible seats by selecting Filters Show Accessible Seats. Guests with accessibility needs should avoid the Warner Building garage, as it is less ADA friendly than other nearby options. The main entrance drop off zone may offer an easier arrival. 1924 Lounge is not wheelchair accessible.
